meta.title: AgentBridge — GitHub Resilience Execution Workflow
meta.subtitle: Step-by-Step Flow Through Unified Resilience Perimeter
meta.description: Workflow illustrating how every authorized GitHub REST request passes through idempotency validation, circuit breaker, rate limiters, cache lookup, bulkhead execution, retry loops, and error normalization.

states.label: Authorized Operation Received
states.description: Operation has already passed PermissionEngine authorization check.

states.label: Idempotency Check
states.description: If operation is a mutation, check in-memory IdempotencyStore for existing key.

states.label: Return Deduplicated Result
states.description: Return previously completed result or wait on in-flight processing future.

states.label: Circuit Breaker Status
states.description: Inspect if github_rest circuit breaker is OPEN.

states.label: Fast-Fail (Circuit OPEN)
states.description: Fail fast in microseconds with CIRCUIT_OPEN error; serve stale cached data if permitted.

states.label: Hierarchical Rate Limit Check
states.description: Evaluate sliding-window allowance across user, repo, and global buckets.

states.label: Rate Limit Exceeded
states.description: Reject request with RATE_LIMITED error and precise Retry-After wait duration.

states.label: Cache Lookup
states.description: If read operation, check CacheStore for unexpired response.

states.label: Return Cached Response
states.description: Return cached value immediately; increment cache_hits metric.

states.label: Acquire Bulkhead Semaphore
states.description: Acquire slot from asyncio.Semaphore(10) to bound concurrent HTTP requests.

states.label: Execute GitHub REST Call
states.description: Dispatch HTTP request with bounded connect and read timeouts.

states.label: Evaluate Response / Status
states.description: Check if response succeeded (2xx), is retriable (429, 5xx, timeout), or non-retriable (4xx).

states.label: Calculate Backoff + Jitter
states.description: Calculate exponential backoff with full jitter (or parse Retry-After header) and sleep before next attempt.

states.label: Cache Invalidation & Idempotency Complete
states.description: Invalidate dependent cache prefixes (e.g. PR list, comments) and mark idempotency key COMPLETED.

states.label: Populate Cache Store
states.description: Store successful read response in CacheStore with configured TTL.

states.label: Normalize Error & Redact Secrets
states.description: Convert exception to GitHubResilienceError and strip all tokens and headers.

states.label: Return Result to Caller
states.description: Deliver clean sanitized response or user-friendly error to Telegram ChatOps.
